problem: The scientific Viewer article had no explicit accessible name relationship, so assistive technology could not reliably identify the Viewer region.
root_cause: ScientificViewerShell rendered an unlabelled article and an unreferenced h2.

change.behavior: A stable per-instance heading id is generated, the h2 owns that id, and the outer article references it through aria-labelledby.

assertions: aria-labelledby equals the rendered heading id
repeated Viewer instances retain unique limitation heading ids

new_findings: CO-029 remains the highest-priority open authorization campaign.
